_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Star/fork/language come live from the API on every run; the description here overrides the repo's GitHub description (none of these four have one set). Setting them on GitHub too is worth doing - it helps anyone browsing your repo list.

projects.description: A mental-health platform built for EduHacks around UN Sustainable Development Goal 3. React front end, awareness and well-being tools, live on Netlify.
Containerised lab environments for technical institutions. Pre-configured Docker images for Networking, Cybersecurity and DevOps courses, delivered through an Electron desktop app.
A digital gallery for art enthusiasts: exhibitions, events, workshops and a blog, hand-built in HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
A job portal connecting seekers with employers. Listings, company profiles and application tooling on a React front end with an Express backend.
